subject: Launching interview slate for Platform Reliability lead — panel schedule & budget check
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sasha Turner <sasha@talentbridge.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Dec 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Launching interview slate for Platform Reliability lead — panel schedule & budget check

Team —

Quick note to get the interview slate moving for the Platform Reliability lead (on-call focus). Recruiting has a short list and one strong referral (attached). Before we kick off formal interviews I need: 1) a confirmation we can open the req this quarter (budget code in place), 2) final panel members (we have 3 engineer interviewers + 1 hiring manager loop), and 3) calendar availability windows so Sasha can schedule.

Attachments: 2026_hc_budget_q4.xlsx (xlsx) — contains tentative headcount slot; daniel_park_resume.pdf (pdf) — referral candidate.

Proposed panel: Marcus (systems + reliability), Karthik (runtime/serving), Laura (hiring manager), plus an optional SWE from Observability (TBD). If you can reply with availability for next-week slots (Mon/Wed/Thu mornings PST) that would be great.

Irene
Irene Choi
Sr. Manager, Platform Reliability
Redwood Inference

--
Note: if budget needs a change request, flag it in reply so I can route to finance.
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Dec 2026 09:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Launching interview slate for Platform Reliability lead — panel schedule & budget check

Irene —

Happy to be on the panel. I can do 12/28, 12/30 in the AM (8:30–11:30 PT). Also happy to swap in someone from my team for the deep dive on long-tail latency if needed — let me know.

One ask: can you push the job description link? I want to ensure we align the technical rubric (KV cache/continuous batching experience) before interviews.

Marcus
Principal Software Engineer
